name: Amazon Pay
line: Let shoppers pay with payment details saved in their Amazon account.

free.text: No setup or monthly fee listed for US accounts

cells.countries: US, UK, Europe, Japan and India
cells.payout: US next schedule; EU daily; Japan every 14 days

fee.math: The rate for a US card charge made on the web or in a mobile app.
The UK rate for sellers taking under GBP 50,000 a month in payments.
The Germany rate for sellers who take under EUR 50,000 a month in payments on average.
In India, prices are agreed directly with Amazon. No standard rate is published.
